profile.headline: Software Developer at Clover Technologies Group
profile.summary:
Software Engineer, Product Support, and Application Developer in various business applications.  Particularly interested in development utilizing .NET framework with Visual Basic C#.

Specialties: Visual Basic .NET, C# .NET, SQL 2005 to 2016.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software development managing internal order entry, warehouse collection, and company integration applications.
positions.insights: Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF), Microsoft Power Apps and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Create and improve upon new and older systems to aid users in inventory management, scheduling, and more.  In addition, create and modify reports for users to see data in a variety of ways.  Work closely with the user base and engineer solutions based on their input.

positions.title: Product Support
positions.description: Utilized a ticket system to prioritize correction of system errors.  Debugged code to discover possible causes and possible solutions for system errors.  Worked closely with the development team to assist prioritization and code fixes.  Independently developed C# & ASP.NET tool to resolve common issues with the system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed applications based on rapid timelines driven by client requests.  Worked in-house for over a year to provide maintenance on existing system.  Utilized SQL and Crystal reporting services to create, modify, and update several reports for clients.
